options.name: api_url
options.description: PX-Backup API URL

options.name: cloud_credential_name
options.description: Name of cloud credential to use

options.name: cloud_credential_uid
options.description: UID of cloud credential to use

options.name: cluster_refs
options.description: List of clusters associated with this BackupLocation Each item should have 'name' and optionally 'uid' Required for CREATE and UPDATE when federated is true CREATE and UPDATE automatically trigger validation on all clusters in cluster_refs On UPDATE, the entire cluster_status map is replaced and ALL associated clusters are re-validated, not just newly added ones For VALIDATE, when set, only the listed clusters are re-validated (must be a subset of the BackupLocation's existing cluster_refs); whe

options.name: encryption_key
options.description: Encryption key for backup data

options.name: federated
options.description: Enable Federated Identity (Workload Identity/OIDC) authentication When true, authentication uses workload identity instead of cloud credentials When true, cloud_credential_ref should be empty Supported for S3 (AWS IRSA / EKS Pod Identity), Azure (Workload Identity) and Google (Workload Identity) Cloud-specific config should be in s3_config (azure_account_name, azure_subscription_id for Azure; google_project_id for Google)

options.name: include_secrets
options.description: Include sensitive information in response

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels to attach to the backup location

options.name: location_type
options.description: Type of backup location Required for CREATE and UPDATE operations

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the backup location Required for all operations except INSPECT_ALL

options.name: nfs_config
options.description: Configuration for NFS backup locations

options.name: object_lock_enabled
options.description: Enable object lock for S3 backup locations

options.name: operation
options.description: Operation to perform on the backup location  - CREATE: creates a new backup location  - UPDATE: modifies an existing backup location  - DELETE: removes a backup location  - VALIDATE: validates a backup location configuration (supports per-cluster validation in federated mode)  - INSPECT_ONE: retrieves details of a specific backup location  - INSPECT_ALL: lists all backup locations  - UPDATE_OWNERSHIP: updates ownership settings of a backup location  - SYNC: triggers backup sync from object store

options.name: org_id
options.description: Organization ID

options.name: ownership
options.description: Ownership configuration for the backup location Required for UPDATE_OWNERSHIP operation

options.name: path
options.description: Path/bucket name for the backup location Required for CREATE and UPDATE operations

options.name: s3_config
options.description: Configuration for S3 backup locations

options.name: ssl_config
options.description: SSL configuration dictionary containing certificate settings Contains validate_certs, ca_cert, client_cert, and client_key options If not provided, defaults to standard SSL verification

options.name: sync
options.description: Trigger backup sync from the object store Only valid in federated deployment mode Can be used with CREATE or UPDATE operations, or via the SYNC operation The sync is on-demand (not automatic or periodic) Parallel sync triggers while another sync is in progress are not allowed

options.name: sync_poll_interval
options.description: Interval in seconds between sync status polls Only used with SYNC operation when wait_for_completion is true

options.name: sync_timeout
options.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for backup sync to complete Only used with SYNC operation when wait_for_completion is true

options.name: token
options.description: Authentication token

options.name: uid
options.description: Unique identifier of the backup location

options.name: validate_cloud_credential
options.description: Whether to validate cloud credentials

options.name: wait_for_completion
options.description: Whether to wait for the sync operation to complete Only used with SYNC operation When true, the module will poll sync_info status until completion or timeout
